explanation: Occupational groups who make a living by catching fish, here represented by Simon Peter and his helpers whom Jesus calls to a new role.
Fishing equipment used to catch large quantities of fish at once; in Luke 5 it symbolizes people's ability to reach out to others when they follow God's word.
A supernatural event that breaks natural laws, here illustrated by the enormous catch of fish that occurred after Jesus' command.
People who have broken God's commands or lived in opposition to his will; Jesus calls them to repentance and reconciliation.
The act where God removes the guilt of sin, demonstrated when Jesus heals the paralyzed man by saying that his sins are forgiven.
Commanding power that Jesus displays when he orders diseases and demons away; this confirms his divine identity to the disciples.
